svg.aria-label: VidyutDrishti. Find the meter hiding the missing electricity. In plain words: Power companies lose money to electricity theft but can only inspect a few homes a day. This compares what each transformer sends out with what its homes' meters record, spots the gap, and tells inspectors which homes to visit first, ranked by how much money is at stake. Under the hood: Four independent detectors (energy balance with subset search, per-meter baseline, peer comparison, Isolation Forest) fused into a capped confidence score: 0.82 precision and 0.93 recall on 20 held-out simulated networks, recall gated in CI. Tool-calling copilot over 8 read-only tools, also served over MCP, with 0 invented meter ids.
